description: Source code for the ue_channel_state_manager class, managing UE channel states, CSI reports, SNR updates, and TPMI calculations in a wireless communication system.

classes.name: ue_channel_state_manager
classes.description: Manages UE channel state, including CSI reports, SNR, and TPMI calculations.

methods.name: handle_csi_report
methods.description: Processes a CSI report, updating wideband CQI, recommended layers, and PMI.

methods.name: update_pusch_snr
methods.description: Updates the PUSCH SNR value and maintains an average.

methods.name: update_srs_channel_matrix
methods.description: Updates channel matrix info and calculates TPMI.

methods.name: get_recommended_pusch_tpmi
methods.description: Returns recommended TPMI based on number of layers.

methods.name: get_nof_ul_layers
methods.description: Determines the number of UL layers based on SINR metrics and TPMI info.
